# token_list_module

## API at a glance

| Method | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `configure` | `configure(config_json: tstr) -> bool` | Set configuration: `{ listUrls?, proxy?, proxyRequired?, refreshSecs?, timeoutSecs?, useEmbeddedList? }`. |
| `config_status` | `config_status() -> tstr` | Whether a config has been SET, and what it is → `{ ok, state, source, config?, counts }`. |
| `init_defaults` | `init_defaults() -> tstr` | Apply the built-in offline defaults, only where nothing is configured → `{ ok, applied, state, source, config }`. |
| `refresh_now` | `refresh_now() -> tstr` | Fetch all configured lists through the fail-closed proxy → `{ ok, tokenCount }`. |
| `get_tokens` | `get_tokens(chain_id: int) -> tstr` | Merged builtin + custom + downloaded + embedded tokens for a chain, each row labelled with the bucket it came from → `{ ok, tokens: [...] }`. |
| `get_tokens_by_address` | `get_tokens_by_address(chain_id: int, addresses_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Metadata for specific tokens only; `addresses_json` is a JSON array of hex addresses matched case-insensitively → `{ ok, tokens: [...] }`. |
| `get_all_tokens` | `get_all_tokens() -> tstr` |  |
| `set_token_enabled` | `set_token_enabled(chain_id: int, address: tstr, enabled: bool) -> tstr` | Enable snapshots the catalogue row; disabling removes the snapshot. |
| `get_enabled_tokens` | `get_enabled_tokens(chain_id: int) -> tstr` | Persisted snapshots for one chain, each with `resolved` saying whether a current catalogue bucket still describes the address. |
| `list_offered` | `list_offered(chain_id: int) -> tstr` | Pinned rows followed by enabled snapshots. |
| `list_available` | `list_available(chain_id: int, query: tstr, offset: int, limit: int) -> tstr` | Offered rows first, then the rest of the catalogue, with search and pagination. |
| `add_custom_token` | `add_custom_token(token_json: tstr) -> bool` | Add a user token: `{ chainId, address, name, symbol, decimals, logoURI? }`. |
| `import_custom_tokens` | `import_custom_tokens(list_json: tstr, replace: bool) -> tstr` | Bulk-ingest one Uniswap-schema document into the CUSTOM list; the caller supplies the bytes, so this fetches nothing. |
| `remove_custom_token` | `remove_custom_token(chain_id: int, address: tstr) -> bool` |  |
| `get_custom_tokens` | `get_custom_tokens() -> tstr` |  |
| `get_list_sources` | `get_list_sources() -> tstr` |  |

| Event | Payload | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `tokens_updated` | `tokens_updated(chain_id: int)` | The rows `get_tokens(chain_id)` serves have changed. |
| `config_changed` | `config_changed(source: tstr)` | The stored configuration record moved. |
